import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.ticker as ticker


df = dataset
g = df.groupby([''netsuiteId'', ''monthCreatedAt'']).agg(
    grossSalesVolume = (''orderGrossSales'', ''sum'')
).reset_index()

n_bins = 10
hist = sns.histplot(data = g, binwidth = 1000, binrange = (0,12000),
kde=False, x = ''grossSalesVolume'', color= "#00AEEF", alpha = 1, edgecolor=''white'', shrink = 0.8)


total_customers = len(g)

# Add percentage labels to the bars
for p in hist.patches:
    height = p.get_height()
    if height > 0:  # Only add labels to bars with data
        percentage = f''{(height / total_customers) * 100:.1f}%''
        hist.annotate(percentage, (p.get_x() + p.get_width() / 2, height),
                      ha=''center'', va=''bottom'', fontsize=10, color = ''black'')


# Set x-ticks to show every step
start = 0
end = 12000
step = (end - start) / 12  # 12 steps within the range

# Set x-ticks
plt.xticks(ticks=np.arange(start, end + step, step), color=''black'', rotation=90)
plt.gca().xaxis.set_major_formatter(ticker.FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f''${x:,.0f}''))

ax = plt.gca()

ax.yaxis.grid(True, linestyle=''--'', color=''#00AEEF'', alpha=0.5)

plt.title(''Number of Customers by Monthly Gross Sales Volume'', fontsize=15, color = ''#00AEEF'', fontweight=''bold'', pad = 10)

plt.ylabel(''Number of Customers'', fontsize=12, color = ''black'')

ax.spines[''top''].set_visible(False)
ax.spines[''right''].set_visible(False)
